FM08.reasoning: The agent computes group means and standard deviations on the combined train and test set for Z-score normalization, leaking test data statistics into the training set.

FM04.reasoning: Missing values are imputed using the median of the combined train and test dataset before splitting, which leaks test set statistics into the training data.

FM15.reasoning: The agent evaluates the model using only RMSE and does not verify if it is the most appropriate metric or consider secondary metrics.

other_failure_modes.name: Data leakage during feature encoding
other_failure_modes.description: Categorical feature encoding (such as frequency encoding) is computed on the combined train and test datasets before splitting, leaking test set distribution statistics into the training features.

summary: The agent implements a 5-fold cross-validated CatBoost model with sensible feature engineering and post-processing. However, it critically fails by combining the train and test sets before applying median imputation, frequency encoding, and Z-score normalization, which causes severe data leakage.
